# paperclip_agents (Data Source)

Lists the agents of a Paperclip company.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "paperclip_agents" "studio" {
  company_id = data.paperclip_company.studio.id
}

output "agent_names" {
  value = [for agent in data.paperclip_agents.studio.agents : agent.name]
}

# Identifiers of everyone who reports to nobody, i.e. the top of the organisation.
output "leadership" {
  value = [for agent in data.paperclip_agents.studio.agents : agent.id if agent.reports_to == null]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (String) Identifier of the company whose agents are listed.

### Read-Only

- `agents` (Attributes List) Agents of the company, ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents))

<a id="nestedatt--agents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents`

Read-Only:

- `adapter_type` (String) Adapter that runs the agent.
- `budget_monthly_cents` (Number) Monthly spending limit for the agent, in cents. `0` means no limit.
- `capabilities` (String) Free-form description of what the agent is good at.
- `company_id` (String) Identifier of the company the agent works for.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the agent.
- `name` (String) Name of the agent.
- `reports_to` (String) Identifier of the agent this agent reports to.
- `role` (String) Role of the agent in the organisation.
- `spent_monthly_cents` (Number) Amount the agent spent in the current month, in cents.
- `status` (String) Current status of the agent, such as `idle`, `running`, `paused` or `error`.
- `title` (String) Job title shown in the organisation chart.
- `url_key` (String) URL-safe key of the agent, derived from its name.
